req.title: Task ids are monotonically increasing
req.statement: The system shall assign strictly increasing integer ids to newly created tasks.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that task IDs must be strictly increasing integers. This ensures that each task can be uniquely identified and that the order of task creation is preserved. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior, a negative test to ensure invalid inputs are rejected, and a boundary test to check edge cases.

tests.name: test_create_task_positive
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Create a new task with valid data.
expected: The task ID is greater than the highest existing task ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a new task
new_task = {
    "title": "New Task",
    "description": "This is a new task.",
    "completed": False
}

response = client.post("/tasks/", json=new_task)
assert response.status_code == 201
created_task = response.json()
assert created_task["id"] > 20

tests.name: test_create_task_negative
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Attempt to create a task with an invalid title (exceeds max length).
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to create a task with an invalid title
invalid_task = {
    "title": "X" * 130,  # Exceeds max length of 120
    "description": "This is an invalid task.",
    "completed": False
}

response = client.post("/tasks/", json=invalid_task)
assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Create a task with a title at the maximum allowed length.
expected: The task ID is greater than the highest existing task ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a task with a title at the maximum allowed length
boundary_task = {
    "title": "X" * 100,  # Max length is 100
    "description": "Boundary test task.",
    "completed": False
}

response = client.post("/tasks/", json=boundary_task)
assert response.status_code == 201
created_task = response.json()
assert created_task["id"] > 20
